senses.definition: Pertaining to the sense of hearing, the organs of hearing, or the science of sounds.

subsenses.definition: (architecture, of building materials) Used for soundproofing or modifying sound.
Of a device or system, using sound energy in its operation.
(weaponry) Of an explosive mine or other weapon, able to be set off by sound waves.

senses.definition: (music) Naturally producing or produced by an instrument without electrical amplification or the need thereof.
(transferred sense, humorous or proscribed) Nonelectric; mechanical or otherwise basic.

quotes.text:
KEY: I've had a banana in banana cake.
WATSON: But you haven't had a sort of acoustic banana?

senses.definition: (usually in the plural) The properties or qualities of a room or building that determine how sound is transmitted in it.
(medicine) A medicine or other agent to assist hearing.
